subject: POC access orchestration, success metrics and next-step owners
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@arborhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC access orchestration, success metrics and next-step owners

Hi Sarah — thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum going: 

Summary of agreed scope:
- 2-week evaluation of Redwood hosted inference for anonymized patient-document summarization and triage routing.
- Primary success criteria: (1) latency: 95th percentile < 120ms for 512-token prompts, (2) accuracy: match/beat current heuristic on recall for triage labels (we'll define eval set), (3) cost: per-inference cost target < 50% of current CPU pipeline.

Immediate asks from your side for our ops team so we can provision: 
- SSO invite via Okta (SP-initiated SAML) for the pilot org.
- IP allowlist CIDRs for your test runners (we'll accept single IPs too).
- A scoped API key for the sandbox environment (we'll produce a limited-scope key with rate & quota caps).
- Small eval dataset (anonymized) + a short list of golden examples for quality checks.

Proposed owners & timeline: 
- Redwood provisioning (API key, temp creds, Okta metadata): Priyom (owner) — target by 2026-10-14.
- Security review & IP allowlist coordination: Aditya (owner) — confirm by 2026-10-14.
- CSM / onboarding: Monica (owner) — kickoff week of 2026-10-18.
- Customer engineering integrations: Alex (ArborHealth) — target pilot start 2026-10-20.

I've attached a short POC success checklist and a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP). Once you confirm owners and IPs, I'll loop in Aditya to finalize SSO metadata and generate a scoped API key.

Next step: can you confirm the security contacts and the IPs or CIDR block for allowlisting? Also confirm that an Okta admin can accept an SP-initiated SAML app.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to a live trial.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@arborhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Murphy <alex.murphy@arborhealth.com>, Priya Desai <p.desai@arborhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 12:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC access orchestration, success metrics and next-step owners

Thanks Priyom — appreciate the clear notes. Confirming we want to proceed with the proposed timeline and owners:

- Customer eng lead: Alex Murphy (cc'd).
- Security/compliance lead: Priya Desai (cc'd).
- Okta admin: Priya will coordinate with our IdP team.

For allowlisting, please plan for the following egress IPs from our test runners (we'll provide CIDRs if you need):
- 35.198.72.45
- 35.198.72.46

On SSO: yes — SP-initiated SAML is preferred. Priya will add the app once you provide metadata.

We can provide a redacted eval dataset (10k anonymized notes) and a 50-example golden set for quality validation.

One ask from procurement: we'll need a short SOW (pilot scope + acceptance criteria) and a standard PO/DocuSign route for signatures. Can you share a draft SOW and your standard pilot terms?

Alex — once Priya shares SSO details, do you want to pair with Redwood ops for initial API key smoke tests?

Thanks — Sarah
VP Product | ArborHealth
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@arborhealth.com>, Alex Murphy <alex.murphy@arborhealth.com>, Priya Desai <p.desai@arborhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC access orchestration, success metrics and next-step owners

Great — thanks for confirming. A few operational details and what we'll provision this week: 

1) Scoped test API key (sandbox, rate-limited, 30-day expiry): placeholder id = rw-test-arbor-001. We'll deliver the key via a secure link (not inline).
2) IP allowlist — we'll whitelist the two customer IPs you provided (35.198.72.45, 35.198.72.46) and also provide a small Redwood egress IP range for webhooks during the pilot (34.82.10.0/24). Please confirm you can accept that range.
3) SSO: attaching our Okta SP metadata (okta-metadata.xml). Priya, once you upload that we will configure attribute mappings: email, name, role. We recommend creating a small pilot group (okta group: redwood-pilot-2026) to control access.
4) Eval artifacts: please upload the 10k redacted notes and golden 50 into the Drive link in the MAP; we'll consume them for the evaluation scripts.

Action items and owners (short):
- Priyom: generate API key + send secure link to Alex (ETA 2026-10-14).
- Aditya: finalize IP allowlist and Okta SP settings in our infra (ETA 2026-10-14).
- Monica: set up pilot workspace and onboarding runbook (ETA 2026-10-18).
- Alex: confirm acceptance of egress IPs and coordinate smoke test (ETA 2026-10-20).

Attachments in this thread: poc-success-checklist.xlsx (high-level acceptance), okta-metadata.xml (SP metadata), mutual-action-plan.docx (shared MAP link).

If these owners and dates look good, I'll raise the secure credential deliverable and loop security for the temporary key rotation schedule (we rotate every 72 hours for sandbox keys unless you ask for a different cadence).

On the SOW/DocuSign ask — I will attach a one-page pilot SOW and send a DocuSign link once the MAP is in place.

Thanks — Priyom
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: POC access orchestration, success metrics and next-step owners

Fwding — Aditya, can you please: 
- confirm the Okta metadata import and attribute mapping (email, name, role),
- provision the sandbox-scoped API key and upload the secure link to the MAP,
- add the two customer IPs and our egress CIDR to the firewall allowlist.

Attachments forwarded: okta-metadata.xml, rw-test-api-key-stub.txt (secure link placeholder).

Let me know if you need anything from Sarah/Priya to complete.

Monica
CSM | Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@arborhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Murphy <alex.murphy@arborhealth.com>, Priya Desai <p.desai@arborhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC access orchestration, success metrics and next-step owners

Thanks team — quick updates from our side: 
- Priya confirmed Okta app created and she accepted the SP metadata. She added the pilot group and sent you the invite (I see an Okta notification).
- Alex verified the test key (rw-test-arbor-001) is working for smoke calls — returned expected tokens and headers.
- Security approved the allowlist including Redwood egress 34.82.10.0/24.

We are aligned to start engineering work on 2026-10-20. Procurement: happy to sign the one-page pilot SOW — please send DocuSign and we'll route the PO.

Next steps for Redwood: please push the DocuSign SOW and include the 2-week acceptance test plan in the envelope. We'll join a kickoff sync on 2026-10-20 with Alex and Priya.

Sarah
VP Product | ArborHealth
